subject.title: [Bug]: sessions_list API only returns main session — all other sessions missing from dashboard and API

question: Should literal session.store paths under agents/<id>/sessions/sessions.json become same-root multi-agent discovery roots, or should literal paths preserve single-store isolation by default?
rationale: The source bug is clear, but the open fix can expose sibling agent sessions for existing literal-path configurations, which is a compatibility-sensitive policy choice under repository guidance.

options.title: Preserve literal isolation by default
options.body: Keep literal session.store as a single-store boundary unless a migration, explicit setting, or maintainer-approved compatibility path opts into sibling discovery.

options.title: Accept same-root discovery
options.body: Intentionally treat literal agent-layout paths as all-agent roots and document that upgrade behavior in the linked PR before merge.

options.title: Replace the branch
options.body: Close or pause the conflicting PR and land a smaller replacement that encodes the chosen semantics with focused tests.

recommendation.title: Preserve literal isolation by default
recommendation.body: Keep literal session.store as a single-store boundary unless a migration, explicit setting, or maintainer-approved compatibility path opts into sibling discovery.

likelyOwner.reason: The multi-agent session-store loader history and current maintainer comments make steipete the strongest available owner for the compatibility decision.
